component.name: Alias Maker
component.summary: A terminal that makes Linux commands easy

description.p: Alias Maker is a terminal for people who have never used one. It runs your normal shell and adds a menu with:

ul.li: A searchable list of every program on your computer, described in plain words
Your own commands: give any command a name of your choice and run it with doit
A command log, so you can always see what ran
/clippy, which looks a topic up in wikis and manual pages instead of running anything

description.p: It always shows the real command before running it, and deleting one of your commands never touches the program it points to.
